data.current_description: Starts a code from a prompt and a destination link (or Wi-Fi details, on Starter). Answers `202` at once with the code processing; with `?wait=`, answers when it finishes (`201`) or when the wait runs out (`202`). The `id` and `shortUrl` in the answer are the finished code's and never change. Send an `Idempotency-Key` so a retry after a network failure cannot make a second code.
data.summary_suggestion: Create an artistic QR code asynchronously
data.description_suggestion: Creates an artistic QR code from a destination URL or Wi-Fi network details (Starter plan). Returns immediately with status `202 Accepted` and a code ID; the code typically finishes processing within a minute. Use the `wait` parameter to hold the request open until completion (returns `201`) or timeout (returns `202`). Include an `Idempotency-Key` header to prevent duplicate codes on network retries. Each code created counts against the account's plan allowance. The returned `id` and `shortUrl` are permanent and never change.

data.current_description: A code's status and, once it has succeeded, its image. With `?wait=`, answers as soon as the code finishes or when the wait runs out, whichever is first, so one request replaces many polls.
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves a specific code's current status, metadata, and rendered image (once processing completes). Useful for monitoring code creation progress.
